newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 6.06 million barrels in the week ended Jan 31 to 295.83 million barrels from 289.77 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 47,000 barrels in the week to 227.31 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 4.12 million barrels to 115.53 million from 119.64 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.42 million barrels to 42.47 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 15,000 barrels in the week to 7.34 million bpd from 7.36 million.
Gasoline stocks rose 2.90 million barrels in the week to 204.20 million barrels from 201.30 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 90.3 percent from 89.1 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.80 million barrels to 38.79 million barrels from 40.59 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 13.71 million barrels from 13.54 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 43.50 million barrels from 43.89 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.14 million barrels per day from 7.84 million, API said.
